description: Comprehensive healthy lifestyle cluster - 9 hashtags covering fitness, wellness, nutrition, and habits

metadata.notes: Test 5: Comprehensive 9-hashtag cluster - 9 hashtags × 4 runs × 600 results = 36 scrapes, ~5,000-6,500 unique videos expected after deduplication. Balanced coverage: Fitness (35%), Wellness (20%), Nutrition (15%), Lifestyle (15%), General (15%). Includes #wellness for cross-cluster comparison with Test 4.
